title: telemetry.jsonl
description: One sample per line, ~1 Hz, written by ui/sampler. See ui_plan.md section 4.1. gpu/host/vllm are object-or-null: a source that fails to read is written as null (never omitted) so every line carries the same key set.

gpu.description: null when the nvidia-smi read failed (see read_errors).

host.description: null when the psutil host read failed.

vllm.description: null when the vLLM /metrics scrape failed or core gauges were absent.

processes.description: Per tracked PID; may be empty if nothing matched.

read_errors.description: Keys are source names (nvidia-smi, vllm-metrics, psutil, thermal, sampler); values are error strings. null when no source failed. Populated on every line a source is failing, not just the first.

gpu.description: Each field is number-or-null: GB10 unified memory makes nvidia-smi report [N/A] for memory, which is written as null while util/temp/power are kept.

cpu_temp_c.description: Mean of /sys/class/thermal zones; null if unreadable.

tokens_per_sec_decode.description: User-visible output tok/s; rate of vllm:generation_tokens_total. null while priming or just after a counter reset.

mtp_acceptance_rate.description: 0-1; fraction of drafted tokens accepted. Primary MTP-health signal. null if MTP off or the metric is absent.

mtp_draft_tokens.description: Drafted tokens over the sample interval.

mtp_accepted_tokens.description: Accepted drafted tokens over the sample interval.
